name: SESSION_CLOSE_FILL_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: SESSION_CLOSE_FILL_20261107 — LQ-20261107-406. /v3/defense/classic read 'STALE AS OF
2026-11-05' on 2026-11-06 because sector_momentum_state held only the 2 STYLE rows for 11-06.
DB truth: ticker_prices had 1,101 bars for 11-06 out of 5,577 quoted symbols and NO bar for SPY,
the benchmark compute_states date-aligns every sector to; it therefore took 11-05 as 'today' and
re-upserted it with no error. The one full-universe writer (price_db_sync.main -> sync_quotes_
to_ticker_prices) runs on the 20 7 * * 1-5 cron, before the session it would capture, so it can
only ever write the PREVIOUS session off a premarket print; every other caller is per-symbol.
These tests pin the fill: the session resolved as the newest weekday whose last quote is
post-close (a weekend or a premarket-only date is never a close), the plan read-only, a dry run
issuing no write, an applied fill narrowed to one session with DO NOTHING so it cannot displace
a bar another lane wrote, broker quotes only, and the sector engine filling before it computes.
Registered because a new pytest file that no gate names is not run by CI (check_test_coverage
